item.title: Netanyahu claims 'historic achievements' in Iran war: 'We made a huge change here'
item.description: Netanyahu says Israel struck nuclear sites, missile systems and senior scientists, weakening Iran’s leadership and infrastructure, while warning campaign is ongoing and Tehran still retains missile capabilities despite setbacks

item.title: Northern Israel under fire as Hezbollah attacks continue; US warns Iran holds major missile arsenal
item.description: Sirens sound in Safed and Galilee; US officials warn Iran still holds thousands of missiles; Hezbollah continues attacks; Trump says Hormuz Strait will reopen soon; Tehran signals conditional talks with Washington in Pakistan

item.title: Vance: 'We did not reach an agreement, are returning to US'; Israel preparing to attack energy facilities
item.description: In the shadow of a 'deadlock' on the Strait of Hormuz issue, US vice president announced at end of three rounds of talks in Pakistan: 'We were quite flexible, Iran did not accept our conditions'; Tehran accuses: 'Excessive and illegal demands'

item.title: Pressure off Beirut: IDF says Hezbollah increased rocket fire tied to battle for key border town
item.description: Israeli forces have surrounded Bint Jbeil for a third straight day, with dozens of Hezbollah terrorists believed to be inside, as Israel assesses the group’s sustained rocket fire is now driven less by Beirut and more by the battle over the major Shiite town

item.title: Hezbollah steps up rocket fire on northern Israel as 5 IDF divisions press deeper into southern Lebanon
item.description: Rocket sirens sounded in Nahariya, Safed and nearby communities as Hezbollah increased fire toward northern Israel, while the IDF said five divisions are operating in southern Lebanon, where troops have killed more than 1,400 terrorists and destroyed 4,300 terror sites

item.title: Hezbollah rocket hits school in northern Israel Arab town, no injuries reported
item.description: Rocket hits Deir al-Asad school after day of repeated sirens across north that damaged homes, infrastructure and power lines near Lebanon border; IDF commanders say troops intensifying operations against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon

item.title: מידע פנים? הרוויחו ב-Polymarket מאות אלפי דולרים על תזמון הפסקת האש
item.description: שוב חשבונות שנוצרו ב-Polymarket ממש בימים האחרונים הימרו נכון על מועד הפסקת האש בין ארה"ב וישראל לאיראנים - וגרפו סכומי ענק. זה מצטרף לחשדות שעלו בנוגע למידע פנים בו החזיקו מהמרים אחרים שזכו במאות אלפי דולרים ואף יותר על תפיסתו של נשיא ונצואלה ופתיחת המלחמה מול איראן

item.title: איפה נופלים הטילים? האתרים שמציגים בזמן אמת את מפת המלחמה עם איראן
item.description: עוד לפני מבצע "שאגת הארי", נולד בישראל אקוסיסטם של מפות והתרעות שמרכז בזמן אמת נתוני שיגורים, יירוטים ושיבושי GPS. יוזמות עצמאיות ואתרי חדשות מציגים לציבור מידע שבעבר היה שמור לחמ"לים צבאיים בלבד. בעולם של איומים מתמשכים, הדאטה הפך לכלי הישרדות של ממש

item.title: Erdogan threatens to invade Israel, says Turkey could act as it did in Libya and Karabakh
item.description: Turkish president escalates rhetoric after US-Iran negotiations in Pakistan collapse, accusing Israel of killing civilians and warning Ankara could act as it did in Libya and Karabakh, reviving repeated invasion threats

item.title: 40 rockets fired at northern Israel; Watch: IDF troops clash with Hezbollah terrorists
item.description: Two IDF soldiers were moderately wounded in a close-range clash in southern Lebanon, as repeated sirens sounded across the Galilee and a building was damaged in Shlomi
